title: A Sync or push still running when tracy-web restarts keeps the site's write lease
steps: Run the push and sync restart cases against a Postgres (TEST_DATABASE_URL).
expect: After a restart with the job still running, a chat may not take the lease.
Once the job ended, the row settles and the lease is free.

tests: a push still running when tracy-web restarts keeps its lease; once its job ends the lease goes (#123)
a sync still running when tracy-web restarts keeps its lease; once its job ends the lease goes (#123)
